summary: Iteration 4: Comprehensive testing completed with focus on test harness fixes and edge case validation. Backend test suite now properly isolates rate limiting tests (42/42 tests passing, 100%). All ROI calculator edge cases verified: zero hours valid (0h/0€, pack10=-79€), blank/negative hours show errors. Mobile responsive testing at 360px and 390px confirmed no body overflow, comparison table self-scrolls correctly. All 28 localized routes working with proper canonical/hreflang tags. Mobile menu app access buttons work correctly with honest dialogs.
